description: This file contains unit tests for the EmailSubscriptionAPI class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing administrative API endpoints related to email subscriptions. It defines test cases for retrieving all subscriptions and updating subscriptions, while other API methods such as create, delete, and getOne are marked as not implemented.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionAPITest
classes.description: Unit test class for EmailSubscriptionAPI, testing endpoints and responses related to email subscription management in the HRM system.

methods.description: Tests the API endpoint for retrieving all email subscriptions.

methods.description: Provides test cases data for the 'testGetAll' method.

methods.description: Tests the API endpoint for updating an email subscription.
